---
name: "nf-core/bam_sort_stats_samtools"
description: "Sort SAM/BAM/CRAM file"
keywords:
- "sort"
- "bam"
- "sam"
- "cram"
components:
- "samtools/sort"
- "samtools/index"
- "samtools/stats"
- "samtools/idxstats"
- "samtools/flagstat"
- "bam_stats_samtools"
input:
- ch_bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM/CRAM/SAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
- ch_fasta_fai:
    type: "file"
    description: "Reference genome fasta file and its index.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(fasta), path(fai) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{fasta,fa}"
output:
- bam:
    type: "file"
    description: "Sorted BAM/CRAM/SAM file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bam) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bam,cram,sam}"
- index:
    type: "file"
    description: "BAM/CRAM/SAM index file.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(index)\
      \ ]\n"
    pattern: "*.{bai,crai,csi}"
- stats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools stats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(stats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.stats"
- flagstat:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools flagstat output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(flagstat) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.flagstat"
- idxstats:
    type: "file"
    description: "File containing samtools idxstats output.\n\nStructure: [ val(meta),\
      \ path(idxstats) ]\n"
    pattern: "*.idxstats"
authors:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@ewels"
maintainers:
- "@drpatelh"
- "@ewels"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/samtools/sort@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/samtools/index@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/bam_stats_samtools@0.0.0-6d1763b"
